div.div:
🟩 graph clock / SCHED_FIFO (reliable timing) 🟧 tokio, non-RT 🟦 RT egress thread (SCHED_FIFO) 🟨 buffer / queue 🟪 receiver ⬜ external / node
Steady audio is SCHED_FIFO end-to-end; the only non-RT steady stages are the ingest codec decode and the Sendspin WebSocket writers (both tokio). All sample-rate conversion is in the PipeWire graph.

Both branches capture from the SAME anchor monitor (one steady QUANT-1024 driver) — that shared origin keeps the Voice PE speaker and the AV receiver sample-coincident.
Inter-device sync: Sendspin = SharedTimeline stamp + the send-ahead lead; AP2 = PTP wall clock + PT=87 anchors.
